newsitem.title: CROATIA: PRESS DIGEST - Croatian weekly - July 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Croatian weekly - July 11.

text.p: Following are highlights of the main stories in Croatian weekly Tjednik. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Commentary: Late Mate Boban, Karadzic's "brother in Christ". Boban honoured on Bosnian Serb Television as one of the greatest fighters against Islamic expansion in Europe.
- The new Zagreb Archbishop Josip Bozanic -- a man for cooperation in the fire of tribulation. Bozanic, advocating reforms within the church, faces numerous challenges in a new demanding environment.
- Do not tolerate neofascism, New York Times correspondent Chris Hedges says in an interview. If Croatia wants to be a democratic European country, it needs the U.S., Hedges says.
- The public has been disturbed by an escalation of violence on the streets of Zagreb threatening to grow into an open war of conflicting mafia circles.
- Domagoj Margetic, 23, author of an open letter to President Tudjman, says he can prove all the allegations about the involvement of state officials in corruption scams.
